reason: The Application Model service became async in #939, but its callers did not change. ModelBroker's to_thread calls returned coroutines (7 model.* tools failed), the sync route handlers returned coroutines (422), and reset never awaited service.project and read with an async connection (500). Execution workers also refused its Core-table graph and edit reads. The fix maps the existing tables (no schema change), reads through the mapped columns, awaits the service in tools and routes, and awaits/run_syncs in reset. Selected: the six Application Model suites (nine of their tests fail on main because of this defect and pass here), the new worker round trip in test_execution_scope_application_model.py (API, tools, reset and project isolation on sqlite and PostgreSQL), test_execution_scope.py (the guard still refuses a Core select over the now-mapped graphs table), and the browser companion and assistant viewer suites that build the same service and tools.
exclusions: test_archived_project_deletion.py (11 cases) and test_migrations.py (4 cases) fail identically on pristine origin/main (un-awaited test client calls / unrelated migration failures), so they are not selected even though archived deletion touches these tables. Playwright areas working-knowledge and assistant-browser-viewer match application_model/** but are excluded: their fixture tests/v3/application_model_fixture.py crashes at startup on main (un-awaited store.create), and the GUI is retired. The supervisor-mode API and model-tool chat round trip was checked on a scratch PostgreSQL Core instead (422/500 and tool failures on main, 200 and successful tools on this branch). No UI, native or frontend code changed. PostgreSQL variants run only where NEBULA_TEST_POSTGRES_URL is set.
